messages: #b#p205##k in #b#m10001000##k says a very old adventure log turned up in the house study.\n\nIt reads like the record of someone who once travelled #bVictoria Island#k, but the middle pages have been torn out, so there is no telling what it really says.

#b#p205##k found a tattered adventure log in the house study, and cannot make head or tail of it.

The middle pages are gone, but the last page still reads:
#e#b"Every hero leaves a mark. But only those who follow the trail will find it."#k#n

A line like that only gets written down over a #rtreasure worth hiding#k. Go and talk to #b#p205##k.
#b#p205##k is sure an adventurer like me can pick the trail back up, and handed over the #b#t2430047##k.\n\nWhatever is left of it, the first page is where this starts.
name: [Event] The Marks We Leave Behind
